reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: flash_loan_withdraw has a non-test caller at reserve.move:231 (borrow_flash_loan). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json, cannot lookup. Gate 3: reserve.move is in scope and flash loan manipulation is a focus area. Code bug confirmed: flash_loan_withdraw (L318-324) only splits underlying_balance without decrementing self.cash, unlike withdraw_underlying (L312), so self.cash appears inflated during the flash loan window, allowing over-valued exchange_rate collateral in the same PTB. However, borrow_flash_loan (flash_loan.move:50) gates access behind PackageCallerCap + whitelist_admin::flash_loan() permission — flash loans are not permissionless. Because exploitability depends on whether an attacker can obtain or abuse a whitelisted PackageCallerCap, the attack path is uncertain. Severity downgraded from Critical to High due to the privileged-caller requirement.
